steps: Attach the X axis to the same logical machine as the A axis
Check the Joint logical machine parameter for both axes
Verify the axes are assigned to the same logical machine
Detach the x' axis from logical machine 2
Check the axis's current logical machine assignment
Use the attach command to assign the x' axis to logical machine 1
Verify the axis is no longer attached to logical machine 2
Verify the part program 'm101.pp' exists in the configured search hierarchy folders.
Check the part program search hierarchy is correctly configured with valid folder paths.
Check the M-code M101 is configured to use mode 4 (trailing subprogram call).
Check the file extension of the part program is '.pp' and matches the expected format.
Add at least 3 control points between splineon and splineoff commands.
Check the splineon and splineoff blocks for correct placement of control points.
Verify the spline type and parameters are correctly programmed.
Edit the block to include only one class 1 preparatory word.
Check the block for any other class 1 preparatory words and remove them.
Restart the system
Check the logical device 5 mapping in the joint parameters
Verify each joint's logical device setting is unique
Set the Joint logical device parameter for each joint to a unique logical address
Check the Device EtherCAT address for logical device 5 is correctly assigned
Ensure no two joints have the same logical device address
Verify the logical device 5 is defined once in the device setup
Check the logical device 5 is not assigned to more than one joint
Disable the OPC UA server by setting `opcua.enable` to `false`.
Check the license status to confirm the OPC UA server option is not included.
Purchase the OPC UA server option if it is required.
Verify the OPC UA server is disabled and the alarm is resolved.
Restart the system
Reinitialise the Ethercat bus
Check the drive's reported error register
Verify the device's operational state matches the Master's expected state
Restart the system
Reinitialise the Ethercat bus
Check the drive's reported error register

Check the Ethercat master log file for detailed error information
Check the drive's reported error register for additional diagnostics
Upload firmware for Drive_3 using the correct file path.
